description: This file defines the Transaction model class for handling customer transactions in the Opencart e-commerce system. It includes methods for adding, deleting, retrieving, and summarizing transaction data in the database.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Model class for managing customer transaction records, including creation, deletion, query, and aggregation operations.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new transaction record linked to a customer and optionally an order, with a description and amount.

methods.name: deleteTransactions
methods.description: Removes transaction records for a specific customer, optionally filtered by order ID.

methods.name: deleteTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes all transactions associated with a specific order ID where the amount is negative.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for a customer, with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total count of transactions for a given customer.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Returns the total count of transactions associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getTransactionTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total sum of amounts for a customer's transactions.
